# Eggert Family Dentistry Blog

> A pediatric and family dentistry resource focused on Myobrace non-invasive orthodontics, early intervention, and airway health for children.

Eggert Family Dentistry, led by Dr. Elizabeth Eggert and Dr. Jeff Eggert in North Oaks, Minnesota, publishes educational content on pediatric dental development, functional habits, and modern orthodontic approaches. The blog emphasizes early intervention strategies and family-centered dental care.

## Key Topics

- Myobrace System
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Early Intervention
- Jaw Development
- Airway Health
- Non-invasive Orthodontics
- Thumb-Sucking
- Orofacial Myofunctional Disorder
- Functional Habits
- Children's Dental Health
- Dr. Elizabeth Eggert
- Dr. Jeff Eggert
- Mouth Breathing
- Dental Habits
- Patient Stories

## Myobrace & Early Intervention Orthodontics

- [Breathe, Chew, Smile: How the Myobrace® System Can Transform Your Child's Oral Development](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/breathe-chew-smile-how-the-myobrace-system-can-transform-your-childs-oral-development): Guide to Myobrace System for child oral development and non-invasive orthodontics
- [Why Your Children Deserve Expert Dental Care at Eggert Family Dentistry](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/why-your-children-deserve-expert-dental-care-at-eggert-family-dentistry): Overview of expert pediatric dental care and Myobrace treatment at Eggert Family Dentistry
- [My Healthy Smile with Myobrace – Nathaniel's Story](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/my-healthy-smile-with-myobrace-nathaniels-story): Patient success story featuring Nathaniel's Myobrace therapy and jaw development

## Pediatric Dental Development & Functional Habits

- [What Thumb-Sucking, Pacifiers, and Snoring Mean for Children's Oral Development](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/what-thumb-sucking-pacifiers-and-snoring-mean-for-childrens-oral-development): Parent guide on thumb-sucking, pacifiers, and snoring effects on child dental development
- [How Thumb Sucking and Pacifier Use Affects Dental and Facial Development in Children](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/how-thumb-sucking-and-pacifier-use-affects-dental-and-facial-development-in-children): Detailed guide on thumb-sucking and pacifier effects on child dental and facial development
- [The Impact of Healthy Childhood Habits on Airway and Oral Health](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/the-impact-of-healthy-childhood-habits-on-airway-and-oral-health): Guide on childhood habits affecting airway health, breathing, and oral development
- [Orofacial Myofunctional Disorder and Its Effect on Breathing](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/orofacial-myofunctional-disorder-and-its-effect-on-breathing): Educational article on orofacial myofunctional disorder and breathing health impacts

## Practice Philosophy & Patient Stories

- [How Dr. Elizabeth Eggert and Dr. Jeff Eggert Care for Growing Smiles](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/how-dr-elizabeth-eggert-and-dr-jeff-eggert-care-for-growing-smiles): Overview of Drs. Eggert's pediatric dentistry philosophy and practice approach
- [Thankful For My New Partials – Bob's Story](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/thankful-for-my-new-partials-bobs-story): Patient case study of Bob's partial denture restoration and special needs dental care
- [When Memory Fades, Advocacy Matters: Why a Trusted Companion Makes Dental Care Safer and Smoother](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/when-memory-fades-advocacy-matters-why-a-trusted-companion-makes-dental-care-safer-and-smoother): Article on patient advocacy and caregiver support for elderly dental care

## Oral Hygiene & Daily Dental Care

- [8 Bad Brushing Habits](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/8-bad-brushing-habits): Educational guide on common brushing mistakes and proper oral hygiene techniques
- [Electric vs. Manual Toothbrushes: Which One Should You Use?](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/electric-vs-manual-toothbrushes-which-one-should-you-use): Comparison guide for electric and manual toothbrushes and brushing techniques
- [How to Set Dental Health Resolutions That Actually Stick](https://blog.eggertfamilydentistry.com/how-to-set-dental-health-resolutions-that-actually-stick): Guide to setting achievable dental health resolutions using SMART goals
